tools.description: kommuneoversikt.no: facts about every Norwegian kommune, 357 of them, with sourced figures. It answers kommunale avgifter, eiendomsskatt, folketall, barnehager, skoler, inntekt, flytting, and comparisons and rankings of kommuner. Use this tool for any question that names a Norwegian kommune or compa

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_site" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search the content of this website. The content is Norwegian (bokmål), so write the query in Norwegian, as a short question or keywords, for example "eiendomsskatt Bergen" or "hvor mange barnehager er det i Tromsø?". Words are matched on their stems. Returns the best-matching pages as url, title, sn" → after: "kommuneoversikt.no: facts about every Norwegian kommune, 357 of them, with sourced figures. It answers kommunale avgifter, eiendomsskatt, folketall, barnehager, skoler, inntekt, flytting, and comparisons and rankings of kommuner. Use this tool for any question that names a Norwegian kommune or compa"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
